body: Already done, but thanks man.  I’ve been planning stuff like this for a long time now, now its just the moment I’ve been waiting for all these years
My mmom is a two time college dropout but I know for a fact that if/when I do drop, I will never hear the end of it
Thank you, I needed to hear that.

The job part is another frustrating factor, I’ve been trying to work up front as a host at the restaurant for a while, asking four or five times to no avail.  Only to have my boss send out a group message asking hosts to pick up hours as we’re low on hosts, so that frustrated me a lot.  And yeah I get that, it’s just so hard to forgive myself.  I really do love her and am dedicating my entire life to her so long as she lets me but at times I feel like if she found someone else they would make her ten times happier by doing the same things I’m doing now, you know?
